unit.title: Questions, prepositional case, and indeclinable nouns
unit.topicSummary: Proposed Unit 5 is a development unit awaiting qualified review. It contains admitted question, prepositional, and indeclinable records, plus separate book self-attestation. Question intonation is not taught. It is not installed and the owned-edition mapping is not signed.
unit.mappingNote: Proposed Lesson 5 mapping remains pending. The structural edition facts are unchanged. This proposed curriculum is not an approved alignment.

objectives.title: Recognize admitted question words and written questions

sessions.title: Questions, place examples, and words that do not change form

steps.title: Questions, place examples, and words that do not change form
steps.body: Proposed Unit 5 uses frozen grammar excerpts and dictionary rows for questions, place examples, and words that do not change form. It does not teach question intonation and it does not supply audio. The owned book remains separate work. Qualified review is pending.
steps.bookDirection: Open Lesson 5 in the copy you own. The app records do not replace that lesson.

sessions.title: Recognize admitted question words and written questions

steps.title: Four question words
steps.body: These words are copied from the frozen table. Кто — Who. Что — What. Когда — When. Почему — Why.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Three more question words
steps.body: These words are copied from the frozen table. Как — How. Где — Where (location). Куда — Whither, where to.

steps.title: Three further question words
steps.body: These words are copied from the frozen table. Откуда — Whence, where from. Сколько — How much, how many. Какой — What kind.

steps.title: Two written questions
steps.body: These written questions are exact frozen excerpts. Что это? — What is this?. Кто это? — Who is this?.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Two more written questions
steps.body: These written questions are exact frozen excerpts. Как дела? — How do you do?/How're things?. Где вы живёте? — Where do you live?.

steps.title: Remediation
steps.body: Return to the explanation. Compare the shown form with the admitted record. Do not invent a form that is absent from the record.

steps.title: Independent checks
steps.body: These checks use only admitted records. A miss returns to the explanation.

steps.title: Two about-examples
steps.body: These examples are exact frozen excerpts. О книге — About the book. О письме — About the letter.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Two more about-examples and a place example
steps.body: These examples are exact frozen excerpts. О саде — About the garden. я в Москве — I'm in Moscow.

steps.title: Two place examples
steps.body: These examples are exact frozen excerpts. Он на крыше — He's on the roof. Он в театре — He is at the theatre.

steps.title: Two more place examples
steps.body: These examples are exact frozen excerpts. Ваза стоит на столе. — The vase stands on the table. Картина висит на стене. — The painting hangs on the wall.

steps.title: Three admitted function words
steps.body: Use these rows only as quoted. Do not build a new phrase from them. в — in. на — on (place). о — about.

steps.title: Two admitted field pairs
steps.body: Each pair is the first field, then the second field, from the same admitted row. кни́га / кни́ге. письмо́ / письме́.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Remediation
steps.body: Return to the explanation. Compare the shown form with the admitted record. Do not invent a form that is absent from the record.

steps.title: Independent checks
steps.body: These checks use only admitted records. A miss returns to the explanation.

steps.title: Nouns that keep their form
steps.body: An indeclinable noun keeps the same form for case or number. In these examples, ра́дио and такси́ are indeclinable. Recognize the behavior of the shown noun.

steps.title: Guided noun classification
steps.body: Choose how the shown noun behaves. Read the explanation after choosing.

steps.title: Four more unchanged nouns
steps.body: The nouns метро́, кино́, пальто́ and ко́фе are also indeclinable. Their forms stay unchanged for case or number. Learn the noun with this behavior; do not infer that every noun with a similar ending behaves the same way.

steps.title: Recognize the behavior
steps.body: кафе́ and меню́ are two more indeclinable nouns. An unchanged word form does not mean that a sentence has no case relationships. These checks classify the shown noun; they do not test production of a sentence or a complete paradigm.

steps.title: Review noun behavior
steps.body:
An indeclinable noun keeps the same form for case or number. In these examples, ра́дио and такси́ are indeclinable. Recognize the behavior of the shown noun.

The nouns метро́, кино́, пальто́ and ко́фе are also indeclinable. Their forms stay unchanged for case or number. Learn the noun with this behavior; do not infer that every noun with a similar ending behaves the same way.

кафе́ and меню́ are two more indeclinable nouns. An unchanged word form does not mean that a sentence has no case relationships. These checks classify the shown noun; they do not test production of a sentence or a complete paradigm.

Contrast кни́га and окно́: these nouns are declinable, so they can change for case. Their nominative and genitive forms differ. Choose the behavior of the shown noun: unchanged for case or number, or able to change for case. No new form needs to be invented.

steps.title: Contrast nouns that can change
steps.body: Contrast кни́га and окно́: these nouns are declinable, so they can change for case. Their nominative and genitive forms differ. Choose the behavior of the shown noun: unchanged for case or number, or able to change for case. No new form needs to be invented.

steps.title: Independent noun classification
steps.body: Classify the shown noun by its case behavior. A miss returns to all four explanations and the retained examples.
